test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Primeval
solution: The correct answer is: **Recent**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Primeval **means ancient or prehistoric, while recent means modern or contemporary. (आदिम का अर्थ प्राचीन या प्रागैतिहासिक है, जबकि नवीनतम का अर्थ आधुनिक या समकालीन है) • The two words are antonyms, meaning they have opposite meanings. • In this question, we are asked to identify the antonym of primeval, so we need to choose a word that means the opposite of ancient. • So, **Recent**, fits this description and is, therefore, the correct answer. Thus, **option 3** is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Autochthonic**, means native or indigenous to a particular region or environment. (किसी विशेष क्षेत्र या पर्यावरण का मूल निवासी या मूलनिवासी) • **Primal**, is a synonym of primeval and means original or fundamental. (मौलिक) • **Indigenous**, is similar in meaning to autochthonic and means native or originating from a particular place. (मूल निवासी या किसी विशेष स्थान से उत्पन्न हुआ) 19c:T930, The correct answer is: **Evanescent**.
